question: Who among the following built the "Adhai din ka Jhopara" at Ajmer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qutubuddin Aibak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aibak **was the **first Muslim Sultanate **ruler in **northern India**.
 
• The **dynasty **he **established **is known as the **Slave Dynasty **or the **Mamluk Dynasty**.
 
• He built **mosques in Delhi **and **other areas**.
 
• He was known as **a generous king in times of peace **and was **honoured with the title Lakhbaksh**.
 
• **Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra **is a **large and imposing structure **in the **city of Ajmer in Rajasthan**, **India**.
 
• It is **one of the oldest mosques **in **India**.
 
• It is **built by Qutubuddin Aibak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alauddin Ghilji **was an **emperor of the Khalji dynasty **that **ruled the Delhi Sultanate **in the **Indian subcontinent**. 
 
• **Razia Sultana **was a **ruler of the Delhi Sultanate **in the **northern part **of the **Indian subcontinent**. She was the **first female Muslim ruler **of the **subcontinent **and the **only female Muslim ruler of Delhi**.
 
• **Nur Jahan **was the **chief wife **and **empress consort **of the **Mughal emperor Jahangir**. She was the **twentieth and last wife **of **Jahangir**
